BETA Close X RS Group PLC has announced the purchase of 499,999 of its ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme. These purchases occurred between June 22 and June 26, 2026, with prices ranging from 595.5000 pence to 620.5000 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 472,347,386, with no shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 29 June 2026 RS Group plc 29 June 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 22 June 2026 to 26 June 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Date of purchase Number of Ordinary Shares purchased Highest price paid per share (pence per share) Lowest price paid per share (pence per share) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share) Venue 22/06/2026 59,629 620.5000 616.0000 618.5102 LSE 23/06/2026 59,485 613.5000 597.5000 603.1329 LSE 24/06/2026 102,887 607.5000 600.5000 605.1370 LSE 25/06/2026 103,306 610.0000 603.5000 607.1966 LSE 26/06/2026 103,294 612.5000 595.5000 599.9141 LSE Since the commencement of this Programme, the Company has purchased 1,702,082 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays Bank plc in accordance with the Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 472,347,386 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 472,347,386. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
